title: CBSE 12th Result 2026 Declared - 85.20% Pass Rate, Check at cbseresults.nic.in
author: Ash K.
summary: CBSE has declared the Class 12 Board Result 2026 on May 13. Overall pass percentage is 85.20%. Girls outperformed boys with 88.86% vs 82.13%. Trivandrum region topped at 95.62%. Results available at cbseresults.nic.in, DigiLocker, and UMANG app.
body: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has declared the Class 12 Board Examination Result 2026 on May 13, 2026. Students can check their results at cbseresults.nic.in.

DetailInformation
Result DeclaredMay 13, 2026
Total Students Appeared17,68,968
Students Passed15,07,109
Overall Pass %85.20%
Girls Pass %88.86%
Boys Pass %82.13%
Top RegionTrivandrum (95.62%)
Exam ConductedFeb 17 – Apr 10, 2026
Exam Centres7,574 across India
Check Result Atcbseresults.nic.in / DigiLocker / UMANG

How to check your result: Visit cbseresults.nic.in → Enter roll number, school number, and admit card ID → Click Submit → View and download marksheet. You can also check through DigiLocker (search CBSE, enter roll number + DOB) or the UMANG app.
Via SMS: Type CBSE12 followed by your roll number, school number, and centre number, then send to the official CBSE SMS number.

Pass criteria: Minimum 33% marks in each subject (theory + practical combined). Students must pass all 5 main subjects. If you've failed in 1 subject, you can appear for the compartment exam in June-July 2026.

Re-evaluation: Not satisfied with your marks? CBSE offers re-checking and re-evaluation. Apply through the official CBSE website within 10-15 days of result declaration. The exact dates and process will be notified separately.

What's next for students: Start your college admission process immediately. Popular universities like DU, JNU, BHU begin admissions soon after CBSE results. Keep your marksheet printout ready. For students considering competitive exams alongside college, check our SSC CGL guide or NDA exam guide for career options after 12th.
